name: Whetstone
description: Sharpens every blow; a guaranteed small bonus on every hit.

name: Lesser Poison
description: A weak venom that occasionally laces attacks.

name: Poison
description: A reliable venom that procs with moderate frequency.

name: Greater Poison
description: A potent venom with meaningful proc damage.

name: Smite
description: The pinnacle strike. It lands often enough that you plan around it.

name: Blessing of Might
description: The pinnacle boon. Sustained, reliable, and never a gamble.

name: Impending Doom
description: A catastrophic curse that rarely fires but devastates when it does.

name: Expose Weakness
description: Reveals a flaw in the target's defence, increasing crit chance.

name: Midas Touch
description: Every hit has a chance to yield bonus gold.

name: Kindling
description: Occasionally doubles the experience earned from a hit.

name: Luminary's Echo
description: PLACEHOLDER. A pinnacle magic awarded at level 5,000. Its entire effect — proc, drop, or something stranger — is designed by the first player to reach this level; everyone who arrives afterwards receives that design and keeps it. Inert until then.
acquisition: Pinnacle reward — level 5000 (design pending first claimant)

name: Wrath of the Ancients
description: The Gauntlet rank-1 aura. An off-cap proc applied to the Gauntlet raid, outside the five-magic slot cap. Rank-acquired only (per-event consumable).

name: Blessing of the Ancients
description: The Gauntlet ranks 2–10 aura. An off-cap proc applied to the Gauntlet raid, outside the five-magic slot cap. Rank-acquired only (per-event consumable).

name: Hollow Point
description: A round bored out and left empty. What fills it on the way in is the argument.

name: Rimefang
description: Frostmere ice that never gave up being water. It finds the gap in a thing and then widens it.

name: Sunder
description: Old Guard siege doctrine, reduced to one word and one motion.

name: Wrathslag Ember
description: A coal off a Manifestation. Still warm, still trying, still not quite a Herald.

name: Kronarch's Last Order
description: The command he gave when the tide went out and nothing answered. It still lands.

name: Keen Eye
description: The Watch teaches it before it teaches anything else: look at the seam, not the shield.

name: Reader's Mark
description: House Sable Vein trains a scribe to find the one line that matters. It transfers.

name: The Veiled Eye
description: Discernment's own nature, briefly lent. It does not see everything. It sees the thing that matters.

name: The Sealwright's Measure
description: Before you can close a thing you must know exactly where it opens.

name: Coin-Sense
description: A caravan lord's habit, distilled. It notices what a room is worth on the way in.

name: Tithe Ledger
description: The Gauntlet has kept one since its founding. Nobody has audited it and nobody has offered.

name: Hoarder's Eye
description: Hoard's dominion is not petty. It is the principle of accumulation itself, and it is contagious.

name: Spoils of the March
description: What an army leaves is worth more than what it carried. The Weir has always known this.

name: The Sovereign's Cut
description: Every climb pays a tithe. This is the arrangement that decides which way it flows.

name: Drillmaster's Cant
description: The Weir's marching count. Nothing about it is magical and it works anyway.

name: Field Commission
description: Promotion granted where it was earned, by whoever was still standing to grant it.

name: The Long Watch
description: Four hundred years of standing somewhere, compressed into the part that teaches.

name: Fragment of the Age of Dawn
description: A piece of a lesson from before the Sundering. The rest of it is not recoverable.

name: Steady Hand
description: Never misses, never surprises. The Weir issues it to anyone who has been startled once too often.

name: Gambler's Sigil
description: Old Guard camp-work, technically forbidden. Enforcement was reportedly inconsistent.

name: Wardens' Metronome
description: It keeps time, and every beat lands. Small, certain, endless.

name: Wick of the Last Lamp
description: It burns very slowly and it has never gone out. Arveth's lamp is still lit on the same principle.

name: The One True Swing
description: Gravewend's peasant got exactly one. The pitchfork remembers the shape of it — and has learned to repeat it.

name: Considered Inaction
description: The archdevil's contribution to the war effort. He thought about it for an Age and then, on balance, contributed this. It is genuinely quite good, which nobody has forgiven.

name: Luminary's Vow
description: PLACEHOLDER. A pinnacle magic awarded at level 2,500. Its entire effect — proc, drop, or something stranger — is designed by the first player to reach this level; everyone who arrives afterwards receives that design and keeps it. Inert until then.
acquisition: Pinnacle reward — level 2500 (design pending first claimant)

name: Ascendant's Banner
description: The first standard planted past the thousandth mark. It does not make its bearer stronger so much as it makes everyone within sight of it harder to discourage — and the less a soldier brought to the field, the more the banner gives back. Adds a flat +120 Attack to every blow struck against this raid, by anyone, for as long as it stands.
acquisition: Pinnacle reward — level 1000 (designed in-house as the showcase)
